purpose: Describe a substitute or a trade-off.
keywords: Verb plain form + 代わりに; noun + の代わりに
I went by bicycle instead of by car.
I cook, and in exchange my brother washes the dishes.
This room is spacious, but the rent is high.
formation: Verb plain form + 代わりに; noun + の代わりに
restrictions: Context distinguishes replacement from compensation or a contrasting cost.
mistake: For serving in someone’s role, に代わって is also common.
